newsitem.title: USA: Rabbi in California charged with molesting girl.
newsitem.headline: Rabbi in California charged with molesting girl.

text.p: Police have arrested a rabbi on charges of molesting a 12-year-old girl attending religious classes at a California synagogue, authorities said on Tuesday.

Rabbi Sidney Isaac Goldenberg of Congregation B'Nai Israel in Petaluma, about 35 miles (56 km) north of San Francisco, was arrested on Monday and charged with one count of lewd acts with a child and two counts of misdemeanor molestation, local police said in a statement. Bail was set at $100,000.

Goldenberg, 58, repeatedly took the girl out of a class where she was preparing for her Bat Mitzvah and into his office, Sonoma County Deputy District Attorney Gary Medvigy said. In his office, the rabbi allegedly made lewd remarks, touched the girl's breasts and asked her to put her hands into his pant pockets, Medvigy said.
The girl told police she had been molested over a four-month period. A representative of the synagogue was not immediately available to comment on the case.
"This is an A-student," Medvigy said. "Suddenly her behaviour changed. She was missing classes. It's clearly affected the girl."

Petaluma Police Sgt. Mike Kerns said the police investigation was continuing to determine if there were any other victims. Police said they were not currently aware of any related cases of molestation.
Goldenberg, who was recently hired by the synagogue, was scheduled to be arraigned in Sonoma County Municipal Court on Dec. 30, Medvigy said.
